title: Review of c06's pcell slip-ring negative: Supported on fresh seed 7 (domain-filling cells by t~13500, 0 persistent splits, no L ring)
summary: I looked at sheet_slip_s0.png and sheet_slip_s1.png, then re-ran the finding's world.py (pcell-yeff-cap with slip mu 2.2) on seed 7 to t=100000 with labkit. As claimed, walled cells form from noise by t=4000 and still number ~30 at t=8500, then by t=13500 four cells fill the domain separated only by thin channels of the outside phase and stay so to the end (rerun/seed7/sheet.png). labkit: 1 final component, 0 persistent splits from 48 splits, merge/split 0.875, max body lengths 3.2, L rim/core 1.38 but rim/out 0.98 and 0/6 individuals membrane-like. The slip drive removes bounded size rather than raising the ring, on a third seed.

observations.B: rerun/seed7/sheet.png: domain-filling cells from t=13500 to 100000; rerun/seed7/FACTS.md: L rim/out 0.98, 0/6 membrane-like, 0 persistent splits, 1 final component

controls_run.B: the no-slip comparator is the parent's packs (20261025T1108-c06-pcell-efficiency-claim pack_seed0/1); not re-run by me

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed at one slip strength (mu 2.2); I did not re-run the no-slip arm, and the domain-filling outcome may depend on vcap and slip_sig, which were not varied.
